Forecast Cancels Saturday’s ‘Hazardous’ Drop Off

by Press Release Sep 24, 2026 1:57 pmSep 24, 2026 1:57 pm

THE VALLEY — From the Naugatuck Valley Council of Governments:

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Due to the forecasted weather conditions of heavy winds and rain associated with the nor’easter expected this Friday into Saturday, the Fall Household Hazardous Waste Collection scheduled for Saturday, Sept. 26, 2026 has been canceled.

We want to ensure that residents and staff remain safe. We appreciate your understanding.

The next Household Hazardous Waste event will be held at Ansonia Transfer Station, 1 North Division St. on Saturday, Nov. 14.
